subject: Who needs to sign and why — ownership roster & compliance owners
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medicore.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-19T15:02:00Z
Subject: Who needs to sign and why — ownership roster & compliance owners

Hi Jordan — great call earlier. Quick recap + asks so we can line up the right people on our side and yours before the demo: 

1) Ask: Can you confirm who the economic buyer is (name + best email)? For budgeting and procurement timing we usually need an econ buyer sign-off.
2) Ask: Who will own security/compliance evidence (SOC2, data retention, access logs) — legal, security, or procurement? Names and emails help us share the right artifacts.
3) Ask: Do you have a preferred procurement/contact for contract terms (legal contact or procurement inbox)?

Attached I’m sharing a working mutual action plan (Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx) and a blank SOW template for your legal team to preview. Ben is copied to confirm compliance artifacts we can provide ahead of your security review.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm econ buyer + security owner by EOD Tue (5/21)
- We deliver a short set of SOC2 artifacts and a suggested commercial term sheet for your procurement by Wed (5/22)
- Quick 30-min sync if you want Ben (SE) + Hannah (Security) to join for Q&A

If it helps, I can draft a one-slide decision RACI from your answers.

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW-template.pdf (doc)

From: Jordan Price <jordan.price@medicore.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Chen <alicia.chen@medicore.com>, Marcus Li <marcus.li@medicore.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-05-19T18:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Who needs to sign and why — ownership roster & compliance owners

Thanks Camila — useful recap. A few quick answers and clarifying Qs: 

- Economic buyer: Alicia Chen, VP Finance (alicia.chen@medicore.com). She will own budget approval but typically asks procurement to handle contract terms.
- Security/compliance owner: Marcus Li, Director of InfoSec (marcus.li@medicore.com). He’s the one who will validate SOC2 and network architecture.
- Procurement: Procurement steers contract paperwork; we’ll loop them once we have an agreed commercial term sheet.

Marcus — can you confirm what level of SOC2 evidence you need ahead of a security review? A short summary or the actual report?

Camila/Ben — Alicia is open to a short commercial summary (1 page) that we can bring to a budget review later this month. If you can draft, that’d be great.

Jordan
Director, Product Ops | MediCore Health

Hi Alicia and Marcus — nice to e-meet you both. Per Jordan’s note, quick context: MediCore is evaluating Redwood for low-latency, private deployment of clinical summarization workflows. Early asks so we bring the right evidence and reviewers: 

- For procurement: we’ll share a 1-page commercial summary and a redlineable SOW/SaaS agreement.
- For InfoSec: Ben and Hannah can share a short SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, and our standard security questionnaire (we can fill yours as well).

Marcus — to your question: we can provide a SOC2/summary package first (control summaries + report extract) and then the full report under NDA if needed. If you can confirm which controls matter most (e.g., change management, logging, data segregation), we’ll prioritize.

Next steps I propose: 
- Camila to post the 1-page commercial summary + MAP link (attached) by EOD 5/20 — DONE (link below).
- Marcus to confirm required SOC2 artifacts (controls list or prefer full report under NDA) by 5/21.
- Alicia to confirm if budget review slot ok for 5/29 (tentative).

MAP link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcd_example-MAP
Commercial summary: attached to this thread.

Cheers,
Camila
